groups.name: crestodian
groups.rationale: Hidden deprecated OpenClaw setup alias; it has no Metiq equivalent.

groups.name: claws
groups.rationale: Experimental OpenClaw Claws are an OpenClaw-specific package concept and are not exposed as a Metiq command group.

groups.name: database
groups.rationale: OpenClaw database maintenance has no Metiq root command group.

groups.name: triage
groups.rationale: Exact triage alias dispatches to the sanitized diagnostics bundle command.

groups.name: dashboard
groups.rationale: Control UI launch and token handoff are OpenClaw-specific; Metiq serves its Web UI from the daemon.

groups.name: reset
groups.rationale: Destructive local reset UX is intentionally outside Metiq's command surface.

groups.name: uninstall
groups.rationale: Packaging/service uninstall remains platform-owned rather than a Metiq CLI command.

groups.name: agent
groups.rationale: Metiq currently exposes agent management through the plural agents group, not a singular local-turn command.

groups.name: audit
groups.rationale: Metiq has security and task audit surfaces but no equivalent top-level lifecycle audit browser.

groups.name: gateway
groups.rationale: Exact gateway alias dispatches to the gw passthrough command.

groups.name: promos
groups.rationale: ClawHub promotional-offer discovery is OpenClaw marketplace infrastructure.

groups.name: telemetry
groups.rationale: No exact Metiq telemetry command group is registered.

groups.name: infer
groups.rationale: Metiq has provider/model management but no stable top-level inference command group.

groups.name: capability
groups.rationale: OpenClaw infer alias; no corresponding Metiq command is present.

groups.name: exec-approvals
groups.rationale: Exact exec-approvals alias dispatches to approval management.

groups.name: devices
groups.rationale: Metiq exposes device operations through gateway/node management rather than a dedicated top-level device-auth CLI.

groups.name: users
groups.rationale: OpenClaw durable local users/email aliases differ from Metiq's Nostr identity model.

groups.name: node
groups.rationale: OpenClaw node runs a headless node-host service; Metiq's node alias manages remote nodes and is not semantically equivalent.

groups.name: connect
groups.rationale: No exact Metiq connect command group is registered.

groups.name: worker
groups.rationale: OpenClaw's restricted cloud-worker runtime is not a Metiq local CLI responsibility.

groups.name: fleet
groups.rationale: OpenClaw tenant-cell fleet provisioning differs from Metiq's Nostr-native agent and Soul Factory lifecycle.

groups.name: worktrees
groups.rationale: Managed worktree lifecycle is deferred with the WS-A/A7 workspace surface.

groups.name: attach
groups.rationale: Claude Code session attachment is deferred until the protocol-v4 session surface is established.

groups.name: tui
groups.rationale: OpenClaw's terminal UI is a separate interactive client subsystem.

groups.name: resume
groups.rationale: No exact Metiq resume command group is registered.

groups.name: terminal
groups.rationale: OpenClaw alias for its local TUI; Metiq does not expose that client.

groups.name: chat
groups.rationale: OpenClaw local terminal chat UI is not the Metiq Web UI or gateway chat API.

groups.name: automations
groups.rationale: Exact automations alias dispatches to Metiq cron management.

groups.name: dns
groups.rationale: OpenClaw DNS discovery helpers are not present as a Metiq command group.

groups.name: docs
groups.rationale: Live OpenClaw documentation search is project-specific infrastructure.

groups.name: proxy
groups.rationale: OpenClaw's debug proxy and capture browser have no Metiq equivalent.

groups.name: webhooks
groups.rationale: Webhook helper configuration is not exposed as a Metiq top-level group.

groups.name: clawbot
groups.rationale: Legacy OpenClaw aliases do not apply to Metiq.

groups.name: pairing
groups.rationale: Secure DM pairing is handled by Metiq's Nostr-native trust/routing model rather than an OpenClaw pairing CLI.

groups.name: directory
groups.rationale: OpenClaw channel contact/group lookup is not a Metiq top-level command.
